name: io.github.gorlix/pallino-mcp
title: Pallino
description: MCP server for Pallino Cloud: spaces, projects, notes and tasks via the agent API.

environmentVariables.name: PALLINO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Pallino API key (pallino_...), with only the grants you want to give the agent.

environmentVariables.name: PALLINO_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone used to compute today's date (e.g. Europe/Rome). Defaults to TZ or the server zone.
